semiconductor_relevance: High — URANO CO.,LTD provides essential materials and processing services that are integral to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: URANO CO.,LTD is a key player in the semiconductor materials sector, offering a comprehensive range of products and services including adhesives, epoxies, die attach compounds, and underfill materials. The company also specializes in metal processing techniques such as plating, electro polishing, and diffusion bonding, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Adhesives and epoxies for semiconductor applications
Die attach compounds and underfill materials
Metal plating and electro polishing services
Diffusion bonding for dissimilar metals and metal-to-nonmetal materials
